_about: 美联储是否在 2025-09-30（含）前降息的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-08-01，只收录该时点之前已发布的资料。

evidence.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
evidence.excerpt: The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.
evidence.claim: 截至日前最近一次 FOMC 会议维持利率不变，9 月是否降息尚未确定。

evidence.title: Divided Fed holds key interest rate steady, defying Trump's demands for aggressive cuts
evidence.excerpt: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 9-2 to keep the federal funds rate set in a range between 4.25%-4.5%. The decision was met with opposition from Governors Michelle Bowman and Christopher Waller, both of whom have advocated for the Fed to start easing.
evidence.claim: 维持利率的决议出现两票主张降息的反对票，说明 9 月降息是存在可能但未确定的路径。
